title: hopcorder — network paths
description: When, where and why paths break: built from the prototype's analysis queries (docs/prototype/schema.sql) on the hopcorder schema.

list.label: Agent

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT agent_id FROM cycles WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY agent_id

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT agent_id FROM cycles WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY agent_id

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT target FROM cycles WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') ORDER BY target

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT protocol FROM cycles WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') ORDER BY protocol

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT protocol FROM cycles WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') ORDER BY protocol

list.name: target_b
list.label: Compare with

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT target FROM cycles WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target != decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') ORDER BY target

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT target FROM cycles WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target != decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') ORDER BY target

target.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, concat(target, ' ', protocol, ': ', reason, ' ', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap((t, f, n) -> concat(toString(t), ': ', f, ' → ', n), ttls, from_ips, to_ips), ', ')) AS text FROM path_changes FINAL WHERE agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Unreachable cycles per target
panels.description: Share of cycles in which the destination did not answer (prototype Q1), for every target of the agent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(target, ' ', protocol) AS stream,
       round(100 * (1 - avg(reached)), 1) AS unreachable_pct
FROM cycles
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}')
GROUP BY time, stream
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Outages
panels.description: Reachability-loss windows: from the first cycle that missed the destination to the first that reached it again. Open windows have no end. Last hop = last responding hop of the first failing cycle.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT start_ts AS start, end_ts AS end,
       dateDiff('second', start_ts, ifNull(end_ts, now64(3))) AS duration_s,
       target, protocol, cycles, last_hop_ttl, last_hop_ip
FROM outages FINAL
WHERE agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND start_ts <= $__toTime AND (end_ts IS NULL OR end_ts >= $__fromTime)
ORDER BY start_ts DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Two-target correlation
panels.description: Unreachable share of ${target} and ${target_b} (prototype Q7). Failing in the same minutes points at a shared transit; failing independently, at two problems.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
       round(100 * (1 - avgIf(reached, target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}'))), 1) AS a_unreachable_pct,
       round(100 * (1 - avgIf(reached, target = decodeURLComponent('${target_b:percentencode}'))), 1) AS b_unreachable_pct
FROM cycles
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target IN (decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}'), decodeURLComponent('${target_b:percentencode}'))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Failed cycles by last responding hop
panels.description: For every cycle that did not reach the destination, the last hop that answered at all (prototype Q2): does the path die inside a transit AS or past it?

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS time,
       if(last_ttl = 0, 'no hop answered',
          concat(toString(last_ttl), '. ', last_hop, if(last_as != '', concat(' (', last_as, ')'), ''))) AS hop,
       count() AS failed_cycles
FROM (
  SELECT any(ts) AS t, seq,
         maxIf(ttl, status != 'no-reply') AS last_ttl,
         argMaxIf(if(hop_name != '', hop_name, hop_ip), ttl, status != 'no-reply') AS last_hop,
         argMaxIf(hop_as_name, ttl, status != 'no-reply') AS last_as
  FROM hops
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') AND protocol = decodeURLComponent('${protocol:percentencode}') AND NOT reached
  GROUP BY seq
)
GROUP BY time, hop
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Where failures stop
panels.description: Failed cycles grouped by their last responding hop.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT last_ttl AS ttl, last_hop AS hop, last_as AS as_name, count() AS failed_cycles,
       min(t) AS first_seen, max(t) AS last_seen
FROM (
  SELECT any(ts) AS t, seq,
         maxIf(ttl, status != 'no-reply') AS last_ttl,
         argMaxIf(if(hop_name != '', hop_name, hop_ip), ttl, status != 'no-reply') AS last_hop,
         argMaxIf(hop_as_name, ttl, status != 'no-reply') AS last_as
  FROM hops
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') AND protocol = decodeURLComponent('${protocol:percentencode}') AND NOT reached
  GROUP BY seq
)
GROUP BY last_ttl, last_hop, last_as
ORDER BY failed_cycles DESC

panels.title: Real loss vs ICMP rate limiting
panels.description: A hop's own no-reply rate is forwarding loss only if the end-to-end rate is comparable (prototype Q5). High own loss with low end-to-end loss means the router only deprioritises time-exceeded replies.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ttl,
       anyIf(if(hop_name != '', hop_name, hop_ip), hop_ip != '') AS hop,
       anyIf(hop_as_name, hop_ip != '') AS as_name,
       round(100 * countIf(status = 'no-reply') / count(), 1) AS own_loss_pct,
       round(100 * (1 - avg(reached)), 1) AS e2e_loss_pct,
       multiIf(own_loss_pct < 5, 'clean',
               e2e_loss_pct > own_loss_pct * 0.5, 'REAL LOSS',
               'rate-limited (ignore)') AS verdict
FROM hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') AND protocol = decodeURLComponent('${protocol:percentencode}')
GROUP BY ttl
ORDER BY ttl

panels.title: End-to-end RTT
panels.description: Round-trip time of the destination's reply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
       round(quantile(0.5)(rtt_us) / 1000, 2) AS p50_ms,
       round(quantile(0.95)(rtt_us) / 1000, 2) AS p95_ms
FROM hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') AND protocol = decodeURLComponent('${protocol:percentencode}') AND status = 'reply'
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: No-reply rate per hop
panels.description: Share of probes each TTL left unanswered (prototype Q6). A band across every TTL from some hop on is real loss; a single hot TTL is usually rate limiting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat('TTL ', leftPad(toString(ttl), 2, '0')) AS hop,
       round(100 * countIf(status = 'no-reply') / count(), 1) AS loss_pct
FROM hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') AND protocol = decodeURLComponent('${protocol:percentencode}')
GROUP BY time, ttl
ORDER BY time, ttl

panels.title: RTT per hop (p50)
panels.description: Median round-trip time per TTL (prototype Q6).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat('TTL ', leftPad(toString(ttl), 2, '0')) AS hop,
       round(quantile(0.5)(nullIf(rtt_us, 0)) / 1000, 2) AS rtt_p50_ms
FROM hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND target = decodeURLComponent('${target:percentencode}') AND protocol = decodeURLComponent('${protocol:percentencode}')
GROUP BY time, ttl
ORDER BY time, ttl

panels.title: Route changes
panels.description: Route changes decided like the agent's metric: silent hops match anything, so a rate-limited router going quiet is not a change (HANDOFF.md §10). Shows the hops that changed and the full path before and after.

targets.rawSql:
WITH paths AS
(
    SELECT seq, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(ip -> if(ip = '', '*', ip), hops.ip), ' > ') AS path
    FROM cycles
    WHERE agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND seq IN
    (
        SELECT arrayJoin([seq, prev_seq]) FROM path_changes
        WHERE agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
    )
)
SELECT pc.ts AS time, pc.target, pc.protocol, pc.reason,
       arrayStringConcat(arrayMap((t, f, n) -> concat(toString(t), ': ', f, ' → ', n), pc.ttls, pc.from_ips, pc.to_ips), ', ') AS changed_hops,
       pc.prev_path_len, pc.path_len, b.path AS before, a.path AS after
FROM path_changes AS pc FINAL
LEFT JOIN paths AS a ON a.seq = pc.seq
LEFT JOIN paths AS b ON b.seq = pc.prev_seq
WHERE pc.agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND $__timeFilter(pc.ts)
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Loops
panels.description: Addresses that answered at more than one TTL in one cycle (prototype Q4), one row per loop. Loops of heavily rate-limited routers are only seen in some cycles, so counts are a floor.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, target, protocol, hop_ip, hop_name, hop_as_name, loop_ttls, reached
FROM hops
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}') AND is_loop
  AND ttl = toUInt8OrZero(splitByChar(',', loop_ttls)[1])
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Path length per target
panels.description: Hops in the recorded path (the destination's distance when reached).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(target, ' ', protocol) AS stream, max(path_len) AS path_len
FROM cycles
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id = decodeURLComponent('${agent:percentencode}')
GROUP BY time, stream
ORDER BY time
